name: v1.7.0
body:
## Features

- Run a SQLite script with `sqlit query -f`. Statements execute in order and the CLI prints the final result. Execution stops at the first error. Use an explicit transaction when all writes should succeed or roll back together. Thanks to @jayhemnani9910 for the original contribution. #352 #362
- PostgreSQL column completion now offers `GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY` and `GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY` in `CREATE TABLE` and `ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN`. #344 #363

## Bug fixes

- Find a table by typing its name even when it belongs to another schema. Tab inserts the qualified name. Thanks to @lucas-becirspahic. #341 #342
- Pressing Enter in Explorer search now selects the highlighted match, including tables nested beneath a connection. Thanks to @liamhawkins and @nihil2501. #333 #360
- SQLite’s TUI keeps a single connection for a multi-statement script, so later statements can use temporary tables created earlier in the script. #364
- Transactional scripts now use the configured SSH tunnel. Closing the transaction executor leaves a tunnel owned by the original session available. #339
- SQL Server’s chunked `FOR JSON` and `FOR XML` results are assembled into one document. Open a JSON cell in the value viewer to browse its tree or syntax-highlighted text. #336 #361

## Dependencies

- The development lockfile now uses Databricks SQL Connector 4.8.0 and oauthlib 4.0.0. A live Free Edition warehouse returned one row for `SELECT 1` through sqlit with these versions. #347

[Full changelog](https://github.com/Maxteabag/sqlit/compare/v1.6.5...v1.7.0)
